verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs confirm DML statements can delete data from tables, which covers the deletion half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents retention controls such as table or partition expiration, retention windows, or configurable time-travel duration; the time-travel mention describes access to historical data, not control over how long it is kept. Missing for 10: documented retention/expiration policy controls, dataset- or table-level deletion lifecycle settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
